records.text: An undisclosed dinner-connected source confirmed to Candace Owens that Benjamin Netanyahu offered to take Turning Point USA to the next level and Charlie Kirk declined.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #5 (Ep OEAHy3SsIiI)

appearances.snippet: It was Andrew Kolvet who told me that Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) offered to take Turning Point to the next level and that Charlie Kirk said no. ... And I confirmed that with two other people, one person who I'm not going to give the clue to, the clue about on the show, because it would reveal a source that was not related to Andrew Kolvet, who confirmed that very same thing.
